newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower in mostly technical trade.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower in mostly technical trade.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended lower in mostly technical dealings prompted by weakness in CBOT wheat, traders said.

Early selling drove KCBT March wheat through support at $3.90-1/2 a bushel, prompting another bout of technical selling. But a lack of deliveries in KCBT wheat prevented the kinds of losses witnessed in Chicago, where 700,000 bushels were posted for December delivery.
KCBT wheat closed 2-1/2 to 4-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with December down 2-1/2 cents at $4.35-1/2. March lost 4-1/2 cents to close at $3.88-1/2.
"Chicago remained on the defensive but Kansas City did not follow suit," a KCBT trader said.

"The lack of fundamental inputs has allowed the technical marketplace to rule and until we get the southern hemisphere's crops harvested, export business or the re-emergence of winter wheat, we'll continue to see wheat react in a technical fashion," the trader said.
CIS was the featured buyer of KCBT March wheat, picking up 1.8 million bushels, traders said. LFG sold 800,000 March and FIMAT bull-spread 350,000 March/Dec bushels at 46-1/2 cents, sources noted.
